name: GPTZero
tagline: GPTZero is an AI detection tool that classifies whether text was written by a human or generated by AI models including ChatGPT, GPT-4, Claude, and Gemini. Designed for educators, publishers, and hiring managers, it provides sentence-level highlighting to show exactly which portions appear AI-generated.
